Soft pieces

Chickpea patties

Csicseriborsófasírt

8 months+ Adjusted 40 min 4 portions

Offer soft patties, broken up if needed. Every chickpea piece should mash, with no hard centers.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 200 g cooked chickpeas (dried chickpeas boiled until soft, or unsalted canned, rinsed)
  • 1 small onion (finely chopped and cooked until soft)
  • 1 small clove garlic (finely chopped)
  • 1 tbsp parsley (chopped)
  • 1 egg (cooked through)
  • 30 g oats
  • 1 tsp olive oil (for the tray)

Allergens

egggluten

Method

  1. Start with chickpeas boiled until completely soft, or use rinsed unsalted canned chickpeas.
  2. Mash them with the cooked onion, garlic, and parsley, leaving only a few soft lumps.
  3. Stir in the egg and oats, and add no salt.
  4. Shape small patties and bake at 190 C on an oiled tray until the egg is set and the patties stay soft.
  5. Cool and squash one before serving.

Adjusted

Dried chickpeas stay hard and difficult to mash if they are not fully boiled, and the usual patties are salted. A dark fried crust is also too tough at 8 months.

Use chickpeas boiled until soft, or rinsed unsalted canned chickpeas. Bind them with onion, garlic, herbs, egg, and oats, then bake them with no salt.
